_readme: TrustedInstaller's emulator stage (#176): boots the EXACT uploaded image in a pinned, checksum-verified emulator.
Nothing is downloaded by imPress. An operator installs the runner, then pins it here: its path and SHA-256.
Until a runner is pinned the stage reports 'not run' (standard profile) or blocks approval (policy ota.require_emulation, on in hardened).
A target whose 'supported' is false, a runner that does not match its checksum, a time-out and any fail marker all FAIL the stage.

s3.why: The production hub image needs an octal-flash eFuse fixture and aborts in the emulator with 'Octal Flash: No detected Flash chip' (#176 comment): treated as a failed qualification until the emulator supports it.
